fields.label: Address
fields.help: The controller on the network, with the OpenAPI's port - 16021.
fields.patternMessage: An IP or host name, with :port - no http:// and no path.

fields.label: Token
fields.help: Hold the controller's power button for 5 to 7 seconds until its lights flash, then within 30 seconds send POST http://<address>:16021/api/v1/new - the answer's auth_token goes here.
